text: hm. ok yeah im confused lol is the lavalamp broken? it doesnt even open anymore [Image #3]
resolution: Same root cause as req_3405 (fixed there, commit 2373b44de): the lamp's doc.blob is healthy and already post-merge (1 range, 654 verts, glass intact at boundary 594) but parts.json was left stale at 3 rows by a torn two-file save during the req_3400 freeze, and the shrink guard refused every save since — the model data was never broken. After hot reload, pressing Save once repairs parts.json to the merged single part. The empty viewport in the screenshot is not yet fully explained — if it persists after the save + an app restart on a rebuilt host (the glass-restore and region doors need the rebuild), that is a fresh bug to hunt with fresh evidence.
